about: Inkling 2 Mini (GGUF · IQ4_NL, text) on the official llama.cpp b12600 macOS arm64 release (Metal), the first ggml-org release with the Inkling 2 architecture. 131,072 tokens, one slot, q8_0 KV, flash attention. -ub 128: the prompt compute buffer grows with context x ubatch (6.4 GiB at 128K/ub256, 3.2 GiB at ub128), so ub128 is what fits 128K beside the 16.4 GiB of weights under the default Metal budget, with no sysctl change. --spec-type ngram-mod drafts from earlier context (code edits, quoting): byte-identical greedy output, 2.2x decode on a code-rewrite probe, no change on fresh prose. --poll 0 stops the CPU spin-wait. Sampling comes from the GGUF. Measured on an M1 Max 32 GB: about 20.5 GiB peak at 72% of the window.
